# bridge

> The outer loop for agentic development. Agents run their own inner loop; bridge dispatches the work, tracks live progress, verifies results, and routes sign-off to a human. Free-tier Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object.

## What it is

- Tasks on a board (todo / in_progress / in_review / blocked / done) with per-agent swimlanes
- Runners (desktop gateway or headless `bridge` CLI) claim todo tasks and dispatch them to agent CLIs (opencode) in isolated git worktrees, one PR per task
- Every run reports progress with completion, confidence, and risk gauges; the watchdog marks silent agents abandoned, bounces stalled reviews, and reaps stuck gate-rejection blocks — nothing parks forever, nothing is fabricated
- Human sign-off: proposed decisions land in a "For Me" inbox; accept/reject with a reason; agents resume on the answer
- Everything (tasks, progress, discussions, decisions, audit trail) is one searchable knowledge base

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/state-vector/bridge/main/install.sh | bash
bridge pair https://your-hub.workers.dev
```

## How it works

- The hub (Cloudflare Worker + one Durable Object, free tier) runs deterministic dispatch loops: sweep, watchdog, ask pause/resume. No LLM in the loop.
- Agents are trusted pollers: they orient via MCP, claim first-wins, heartbeat, finish with a PR.
- Finishing spawns a fresh-session Verify task; work isn't done until receipts check out.
- Decisions are human-authoritative: agents propose, a human accepts in the web UI.

## Agent MCP surface

orient · create_artefact · transition (claim/block/finish) · log_progress (heartbeat + gauges incl. context_pct, how full the agent's context window is) · ask_agent / answer_ask · search_knowledge · get_artefact / get_history.

Sessions are small and single-purpose by design: one claim per session, verification in a fresh session, analysis → fresh impl session. context_pct makes context pressure visible so hand-offs happen before quality degrades.

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/state-vector/bridge
- License: Apache-2.0

## Surfaces

- Web: board, top, log, knowledge, discussions, briefs (per-section provenance receipts), For Me inbox (proposed decisions: accept/reject)
- Gateway: desktop app + headless CLI (dispatch log, agent config, WIP limits, device-flow pairing)
- Mobile (iOS): fleet summary + For You (coming soon)

## Task kinds

One task type, five kinds; shared status machine (todo → in_progress → in_review → done; blocked with reason + unblock condition; silence = abandoned; in_review bounces back with findings; parents can't complete with open children). Each kind's flow is server-enforced:

- impl: exclusive claim; PR-gated finish → Verify auto-spawns; done only after verify completes, by a different session (separation of duties); needs qualification (done analysis child or accepted decision)
- analysis: exclusive claim; breakdown/evidence output; done releases the parent's claim (impl continues in a fresh session)
- review: verify duty; outranks the whole pool; receipts required to complete; bounce returns parent to author; verify-of-verify structurally blocked
- research: exclusive claim; completes with a knowledge artefact link
- question: open, nobody claims, many contribute via progress; author closes with a decision

Pool priority (enforced in orient): unblock tasks → blocked-with-condition → verify duty → questions → plain impl work.

Cross-kind invocations (server-spawned): impl blocked → auto-spawns Unblock child; impl/analysis/research in_review → auto-spawns Verify child (receipts gate); question closed → decision derived_from it; analysis done → releases parent impl claim; review done/bounce → closes/bounces the parent.

Other types: steering (constrains), goals (tasks implement), decisions (human-accepted), progress (append-only), agents (registry).

- Hosted: $5/month (coming soon); waitlist via repo discussions
